movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Armed hand gestures handling the jemparing (bow and arrow) and unsheathing or brandishing the cundrik dagger.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Can be staged flexibly as a solo, in paired duels/partnerships, or as a synchronized group formation.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Controlled torso and hip carriage wrapped in a dodot and belt over knee-length trousers.
movement_profile.partnering: Can be performed solo, in pairs, or in groups.
movement_profile.posture: Disciplined female warrior posture blending refined Surakarta-style court alignment with grounded Prajuritan martial readiness.

signature_moves.description: Drawing arrows (nyenyep) from the quiver (endhong) and aiming the bow (gendewa).
signature_moves.name: Jemparing manipulation

signature_moves.description: Martial posture integrating the short dagger into defensive and offensive stage displays.
signature_moves.name: Cundrik stance

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Shifts dynamically between the steady cadence of lancaran, the urgent momentum of srepeg, and the lyrical tension of palaran.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Loose modern posturing; casual handling of ceremonial stage weapons (bows, arrows, daggers).

music_profile.musical_form: Transitions across lancaran, srepeg, and palaran compositions
music_profile.sound_description: A Javanese gamelan ensemble playing in the pelog scale, marked by the resonant punctuations of the gong, kempul, and kenong, balanced by the rhythmic drive of the kendhang barrel drum and melodic metallophones including the gender, demung, and saron, shifting through lancaran, srepeg, and palaran sections.
music_profile.vocal_style: palaran singing where applicable within the gamelan structure

basic_steps: Assume a balanced warrior stance carrying the gendewa (bow) and cundrik (dagger).
Execute Prajuritan-derived martial footwork blended with Surakarta classical body alignment.
Draw the nyenyep (arrow) from the endhong (quiver) and nock to the gendewa.
Manoeuvre through floor pathways transitioning between lancaran and srepeg musical structures.
teaching.formation: Solo, pairs, or group bregada line formations
teaching.level_notes: Requires coordination of handheld traditional weaponry (bow, arrows, dagger) with Javanese classical and folk movement registers.
teaching.rhythm: Pelog gamelan structures featuring lancaran, srepeg, and palaran meters
